question: In each quarter-second around the cue, how closely does the shape of a scalp voltage trace follow the shape of an eye-electrode trace? Compare against a different trial of the same cue.
source: Ofner et al., Zenodo 834976 v1. Exactly the 21 files in ../agreement/source-files.json (SHA-256 662b5406673ec0f4909429f08ee0f0f63bfa8388595dd9e6fbc1ae4d75095873). Local motor execution, participants 1–7, runs 1–3. Verify named files against their byte count, MD5 and SHA-256. Open no other GDF. Reuse the existing fixed channel order, float64 calibration and native event parser. Verify all seven cues 0x600–0x606 occur six times/run with unique ordered onsets, precursor triplet at minus 1024 and matching end at plus 1536.
montage: For two-site means, average simultaneous scalp samples first. For C3_minus_C4 subtract C4 from C3 at every tick. Each eye column is taken as stored. Because outer labels reverse in three runs, never assign the corresponding group trace to a left or right eye.
pairing: For every trial compare its scalp samples with simultaneous eye samples and with eye samples at the same cue-relative ticks of the next chronological trial with the same cue in that same run, wrapping six to one. Pool all seven cue types. Require both correlations defined for identical contributing trial pairs. No target, motion input, filter, rectification, rereference or resampling. Never shift within the 128-sample waveform.

scopes.finite_pairs: Report paired results only if all three 128-sample traces are finite and nonconstant. An exactly constant trace makes correlation undefined. Record missing pair counts. An out-of-bounds or unexpected source stops the build.
scopes.baseline_screened_pairs: Use the original additional descriptive sensitivity rule for both recipient and next-trial donor. Nine input channels (six individual scalp sites and the three eye columns) must have finite input at t-128..t+128 and each channel's strictly pre-cue population SD must exceed 1e-8 and fall inclusively within [0.1,5] times that channel's positive run median SD over trials with finite baselines. This retrospective check only characterizes the training sample.

metrics.median_abs_r: Pearson correlation magnitude in each 128-tick window. Take the median over eligible trials per run, median of three runs in each person, then median across people. Retain signless result on 0–1. Check all 48 existing bilateral comparison cells (two windows, four combinations, three eyes, two scopes) against the previously qualified aggregate to absolute tolerance 1e-12 and counts exactly.
metrics.mean_r2: Square each trial's Pearson correlation first. Take the arithmetic mean across eligible trials within run, then the equal-weight arithmetic mean over three run means for each person, then the equal-weight arithmetic mean across people. This describes the average fraction of within-window scalp variance captured by a fresh one-predictor straight-line fit with intercept on that same trial window. Do not square the cohort median, pool samples across people, interpret as a causal percentage or infer out-of-sample predictive skill.

support: For each cell and metric report the cohort statistic and 25th/75th percentiles of the unlabelled person summaries for each pairing (linear interpolation at (n-1)*q). Also report the number of people with higher, tied and lower same-trial than shifted summaries within person, the eligible person/run/trial counts and the minimum/maximum eligible trial count across contributing people. Require at least one complete matched pair per run and all three runs for a person. Count only contributing runs/trials in reported support. Record total evaluated trial pairs and nonfinite/constant exclusions per cell, overlapping causes separately. Report no labelled individual, trial trace or pairing row. IQR describes participant spread; no confidence interval, p-value, population or causal claim.
release: Default to the prespecified C3/C4 mean, eye 63, postcue, all finite pairs and mean r-squared. Let the reader switch all choices; show both controls and both windows together. Mark only measured single sites or the two members of a selected spatial combination on the template. The arm is illustrative, the comparison includes all seven cues; eye-electrode positions are not inferred. Preserve earlier reader modes, sources, rights, code, reproducible offline HTML and explicit ZIP inventory.
